What happens when sodium atoms combine with chlorine atoms to form sodium chloride?
A
Sodium atoms each gain one electron, and chlorine atoms each lose one electron.
B
Sodium atoms each lose one electron, and chlorine atoms each gain one electron.
C
Sodium atoms and chlorine atoms share one electron with each other.
D
Sodium atoms and chlorine atoms share two electrons with each other.
